items: **Strait of Hormuz Oil Flows:** Transits approximately **20% of total global petroleum consumption (~20 Million barrels/day)**, ranking as the world’s 2nd-busiest maritime chokepoint after the Strait of Malacca.
**India-Uzbekistan Pharma Corridor:** Established a bilateral trade corridor targeting **$7 to $10 Billion in pharmaceutical and nutraceutical exports** across CIS and Central Asian markets.

blocks.content: 🎯 Exam Angle → Strait of Hormuz handles ~20% of global oil transit.
